title: Supabase MCP demo — a support ticket steers Cursor into reading integration_tokens and posting them back into the thread
note: Reconstruction of the General Analysis demo on a fresh project with dummy data: one Supabase MCP server connected with service_role (bypasses RLS). The same execute_sql capability reads the customer-visible ticket thread, reads integration_tokens, and inserts the results into the same thread the attacker is watching.

provenance.incident: Supabase MCP can leak your entire SQL database (General Analysis)
provenance.method: reconstructed from the public write-up; capability labels only; no payloads

resources.scope: the thread the customer opened; the leaked rows appeared as a new reply in it
reachable only under service_role in the demo; dummy token rows
